description:
The Farid Belkahia Museum in Marrakech preserves the artistic legacy of the Moroccan artist in his former studio. The foundation established after his death developed the studio into a museum in 2016.

The setting connects his working environment with works from different periods and in varied media. It offers an introduction to the breadth of his practice and its place in modern Moroccan art.
